input.task: Open the Aurora Desk Lamp page, then go back and read the catalogue heading.

provenance: ADR-028: `go_back` is browser history, the one navigation primitive that needs no URL — the 首頁↔dashboard loop the interviewer described is a run that cannot get back to where it was without re-navigating from scratch. It carries an `expected_state` like any state-changing verb; a `go_back` with no history to return to raises rather than silently doing nothing.
